description: A Java class providing utilities for performing search queries that ensure result deduplication based on a specified unique key, with support for complex query joins and handling interaction with Hibernate Search and Lucene. It manages multiple search scenarios including counting, paginating, and combining multiple search queries while respecting Lucene's clause limits.

classes.name: SearchQueryUnique
classes.description: Provides methods for removing duplicate search results based on a specified unique key, supporting complex search joins and managing search result fetching for Hibernate Search coupled with Lucene limitations.

methods.name: getScope
methods.description: Returns the class scope of the search query.

methods.name: getSearch
methods.description: Returns the search predicate function used in the query.

methods.name: getMapper
methods.description: Returns the function used to map index results to final result type.

methods.name: getUniqueKey
methods.description: Returns the name of the field used as a unique key for deduplication.

methods.name: getJoinedQuery
methods.description: Returns the joined query if any.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Sets the joined query to facilitate complex query chaining for deduplication.

methods.name: newQuery
methods.description: Creates a new SearchQueryUnique instance for a specified scope, search predicate, unique key, and optional mapper.

methods.name: searchCount
methods.description: Performs a search to fetch only the total hit count for the specified query.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search returning a list of results, with overloads for pagination and total hit count.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the search considering joins, filtering, and deduplication, supporting pagination and optional total hit count.
